capabilities: Applies Feishu-style paragraph spacing and line height in Live Preview and Reading view
Inserts headings, lists, tasks, code blocks, callouts, links and tables from a toolbar
Copies selected images, videos and files into the vault attachment folder
Sets the alignment of standalone images
Turns the hover and slash toolbar shortcuts on or off
disambiguation: Not a block-reference or block-editing tool; it changes paragraph layout and adds an insert toolbar.
extras: Desktop only; the plugin interface is in Simplified Chinese. Attachment import reads only files chosen in the system file picker and runs locally.
problem: Obsidian's default paragraph spacing and line breaks do not match Feishu documents, and inserting blocks means typing Markdown by hand.

relations.evidence: Feishu Lite Blocks brings Feishu-inspired paragraph spacing and a quick-insert toolbar to Obsidian Desktop.

summary: Adds Feishu-style paragraph spacing, Shift+Enter soft line breaks, and a hover or slash quick-insert toolbar for blocks and attachments.
